title: revlens example manifest
description: example.json of an example: what a picker needs to offer it. Like history.schema.json this is not an engagement record - it describes the example itself, so that Try an Example can list what a build ships without a hard-coded table, and README.md can stay written for people.

id.description: Directory name of the example; a picker returns it and the seeding resolves it

languages.description: ISO 639-1 codes of the variants, in the order a picker should show them. The first is the fallback when the reader's language is not among them.

title.description: One line per language, keyed by code - what the picker's row says

description.description: A sentence per language, keyed by code - what this example teaches

build.description: What building this example needs, declared rather than assumed by the caller

source.description: Source adapter that reads these records, see `revlens sources`

from.description: Baseline revision; a tag the history carries, because a hash differs on every seeding
